claim.format: permission names sorted, comma-joined, no spaces; "" for none; "*" passes everything

permissions.name: content:generate
permissions.description: Generate questions, learning objectives, item suggestions and module plans.

permissions.name: content:review
permissions.description: Accept, reject and edit suggestions; act on module-generation jobs; list suggestions and jobs.

permissions.name: catalog:edit
permissions.description: Edit the workspace catalog: choices, competencies, disciplines, subjects, difficulties, curricula, items, topics, syndromes and learning objectives (with import); delete catalog entries.

permissions.name: catalog:view-hidden
permissions.description: See hidden curricula and read multimedia by id.

permissions.name: files:manage
permissions.description: Read and delete uploaded files by id.

permissions.name: psychometrics:view
permissions.description: See question-bank psychometrics: dashboard stats and stats.

permissions.name: course:manage
permissions.description: Create and change courses, modules, sessions and resources; sync the knowledge base.

permissions.name: cohort:manage
permissions.description: Create and change cohorts.

permissions.name: cohort:view
permissions.description: See cohort rosters and learner metrics.

permissions.name: results:view
permissions.description: See exam results and read feedback.

permissions.name: faculty:ask
permissions.description: Use the faculty assistant (the faculty allowlist still applies).

permissions.name: members:view
permissions.description: See the workspace members list and invites.

permissions.name: members:invite
permissions.description: Invite people to the workspace, one by one or by import.

permissions.name: members:manage
permissions.description: Change members' roles and remove members.

permissions.name: roles:manage
permissions.description: Create, change and delete the workspace's roles. Owner only by default.

permissions.name: catalog:edit-global
permissions.description: Edit the global (MedAI) catalog shared by every workspace.

permissions.name: tutor:prompts
permissions.description: Read and change tutor prompts.

permissions.name: tutor:analytics
permissions.description: See tutor analytics.

permissions.name: accounts:blocks-delete
permissions.description: Delete exam blocks under any account (/accounts/{accountId}/blocks).

permissions.name: platform:prompts
permissions.description: Read the platform prompt catalog.

permissions.name: platform:settings
permissions.description: Change platform settings: app status, app version, session size caps.

permissions.name: platform:audit
permissions.description: Read study-plan audits.

permissions.name: platform:accounts
permissions.description: Manage any account.

permissions.name: platform:psychometrics
permissions.description: Run and see psychometrics across every workspace.

permissions.name: platform:tenants
permissions.description: Create and change workspaces (tenants), including paying.

permissions.name: platform:skills
permissions.description: Publish and change assistant skills.

permissions.name: platform:promo
permissions.description: Manage promo codes.

permissions.name: platform:partners
permissions.description: Manage partners, agreements and payouts.

permissions.name: platform:team-cards
permissions.description: Manage team contact cards.

permissions.name: platform:impersonate
permissions.description: Sign in as another user.

permissions.name: platform:users
permissions.description: Change and delete users and their platform roles.

permissions.name: platform:notify
permissions.description: Send notifications to users.

roles.name: Owner
roles.description: Runs the workspace: every workspace permission, including roles.

roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Manages the workspace, its content and its members, but not its roles. Cannot grant Owner.

roles.name: Student
roles.description: Studies in the workspace. No management permissions.

legacy.description: For a token without the claim: roles == superadminRole -> ["*"]; tenant in medaiTenants -> staff bundle when roles == staffRole, else none; otherwise tenantRoleBundles[tenant_role] -> that role's permissions, else none. Exact, case-sensitive matches.
